qualification: The Statistics screen re-parses HTML date-input strings through new Date('YYYY-MM-DD'), which is UTC midnight; in timezones behind UTC that becomes the previous local calendar day before the database range is constructed.
pass_rule: For a selected 2026-08-16 date, both init and custom updateRange must pass local calendar date 2026-08-16 to getDataFromDb in America/New_York and Asia/Tokyo. Existing custom-range/settings/database invariants and all source outside init/updateRange must remain unchanged. Exact winner replay must pass.
fallback: One frozen Claude Sonnet 5.5 call only after autonomous miss.
